meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆分开发任务为多个独立小改动,自动验证后逐个合并上线。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把开发任务变成多个独立小改动,逐个通过验证并合入主分支。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one dev task into small verified changes that merge one by one.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn dev tasks into small changes requiring individual review and merge.

howto.what: 它把实现工作放进独立的 git worktree,走完整 PR 流程:驱动 ulw-loop 实现并强制留下人工 QA 证据、写英文 PR、循环跑 CI 与 Cubic 直到通过、默认自动合并并清理 worktree;还会把任务拆成最小的独立 PR。
howto.when: 当实现工作需要以 PR 形式落地时接管:你说「create a PR」「implement and PR」「split into atomic PRs」等说法,或只说「实现 X」但语境意味着走 PR 交付时触发。

say.text: 把这个任务实现出来并开一个 PR
say.note: 会新建 worktree,按流程推进实现与验证

say.text: 把这个需求拆成最小的原子 PR,能并行的并行做
say.note: 每个 PR 一个 worktree 并行推进

say.text: 把这个 issue 实现并以 PR 落地,合并后清理 worktree
say.note: 默认自动合并,然后清理 worktree

howto.what_en: It runs the full PR lifecycle in a task-owned git worktree: implementation via ulw-loop with mandatory manual QA evidence, an English PR, a CI/Cubic verification loop, auto-merge by default, then worktree cleanup. Splits tasks into atomic PRs.
howto.when_en: It takes over whenever implementation work must land as a PR — say “create a PR”, “implement and PR”, “split into atomic PRs”, or just “implement X” when the context implies PR delivery.

say_en.text: Implement this and open a PR for it.
say_en.note: Creates a worktree and runs the lifecycle.

say_en.text: Split this into the smallest atomic PRs and build independent ones in parallel.
say_en.note: One worktree per PR, run concurrently.

say_en.text: Implement this issue, land it as a PR, and merge it.
say_en.note: Merges by default, then cleans up worktrees.
